inputs.utterance: create a calc that condenses spend categories into groups of 'Travel', 'Payroll' and 'Other' based on the first word

calculatedFieldFormula.formula: CASE LEFT([Spend Category], FIND([Spend Category], ' ') - 1) WHEN 'LinkedIn' THEN 'Social Media' WHEN 'Facebook' THEN 'Social Media' WHEN 'Twitter' THEN 'Social Media' WHEN 'Google' THEN 'Search' WHEN 'Bing' THEN 'Search' WHEN 'Baidu' THEN 'Search' ELSE 'Other' END
